2.1.2 Activities of the Board of Directors during 2022

In 2022, the activities of the Board of Directors were sustained through 10 Board meetings.

Strategic guidelines

Climate Strategy and Medium-Term Plan were the two themes at the heart of the Board’s debates in 2022.
At the beginning of the year, the Board focused on the definition of the Amundi Climate Strategy, which it submitted for the first time to the opinion of the General Meeting in 2022.
